sources.excerpt: Fulltone OCD-Germanium | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Fulltone OCD-Germanium OCD-Germanium The Fulltone OCD-Germanium is a Custom Shop overdrive pedal featuring a unique circuit design with 2 Mosfets and 2 Germanium diodes. This pedal offers a tube-like feel, enhanced sustain, and a focused single-note tone. Experience a wider dynamic range and exceptional definition. Built in the USA, the OCD-Germanium delivers a versatile sound that sits between blues and greens. Explore the world of overdrive with this exceptional pedal. What Fulltone say about the OCD-Germanium The OCD pedal is the only pedal that uses 2 x Mosfets configured as hard-clipping to 'Voltage reference" instead of the usual way: to ground." The earliest OCDs used 2 x Mosfets plus 1 x Germanium diode, but very quickly these diodes became harder and harder to find, and they became expensive. Recently I stumbled across a reasonably large stash of the right kind of Germanium diodes so I ponied-up and bought all of them. So I decided to do a run of the ultimate OCD: a Custom Shop offering with a few circuit tweaks using 2 x Mosfets plus 2 x Germanium diodes, and one hell of a beautiful paint job... Metallic Teal with a chrome undercoat! This beauty morphs between blues and greens depending on the light and angle. And what would the ultimate OCD be without a Blue LED? The sound? Great definition, more tube-like feel, a bit wider dynamic range, more sustain, and a more focused single-note tone. And as with all Fulltone pedals... 100% Built in the USA. www.fulltoneusa.com OCD-Germanium compared to ...
